picks.title: Splice's new AI DAW feels like a cheat code for music production
picks.excerpt: Splice launches Create in beta: a free Mac DAW built around the Splice library with a voice-controlled AI chatbot, Rheo, that can teach you to make a track or assemble a full song from Splice samples and stock instruments.
picks.rationale: Brand-new free AI-native DAW from the biggest sample platform; producers can try it today.

picks.title: Pro Tools now features AI stem separation
picks.excerpt: Avid's Pro Tools 2026.11 adds an AI stem separation extension that splits any recording into up to six stems (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys, other) via drag-and-drop.
picks.rationale: The industry-standard studio DAW ships built-in six-stem AI separation in 2026.11, so engineers no longer need a separate tool for it.

picks.title: ElevenLabs now lets users publish AI-generated music directly on SoundCloud
picks.excerpt: ElevenLabs' Eleven Music now publishes tracks straight to SoundCloud without a download step; the company says more than 25 million tracks have been generated with its music models.
picks.rationale: Generation-to-distribution pipe goes live on a major platform (25M+ tracks generated so far); TechCrunch chosen over the Verge write-up of the same story.

picks.title: DDEX Announces ElevenLabs as First AI Company to Join Membership
picks.excerpt: Music metadata standards body DDEX has admitted ElevenLabs as its first AI-company member, bringing an AI music generator into the industry's delivery/metadata standards process.
picks.rationale: For the first time an AI generator gets a seat in the body that sets music delivery and metadata standards, which bears on how AI tracks get labelled and credited.

picks.title: PianoBench: Evaluating Musical Perception and Reasoning in Language Models
picks.excerpt: New benchmark and 20,000+ hour multimodal piano dataset (interleaved audio, symbolic transcripts and speech) testing which musical features multimodal language models can actually perceive and reason about.
picks.rationale: New benchmark plus a 20,000-hour piano dataset that measures which musical features multimodal LLMs actually hear. This is the research slot, and it widens the outlet spread.
